svg.title: CI/CD Pipeline
svg.desc: Application checks precede Docker delivery. The package is exported, verified, restored and tested. Publication is restricted to push or manual dispatch on main, with no public-cloud deployment.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Triggers
PR targeting main
Push to main
workflow_dispatch

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ubuntu 24.04
Python 3.13 · Node.js 22
PostgreSQL 16 · CPU PyTorch
Chromium and WebKit

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Python checks
unittest → Mypy
PostgreSQL / YOLO integration

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Frontend checks
ESLint → TypeScript
Production build

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Browser tests
Regression: includes simulated APIs
Full-system: real application stack

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Preserve test evidence
Logs, versions and failure traces
Upload when not cancelled

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ubuntu 24.04
Build backend and frontend
Fetch PostgreSQL image
Test source stack

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Package tested images
delivery.py package / docker save
Compose, manifest and support files

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Verify and restore
SHA256SUMS → docker load
Match image IDs to manifest

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Test restored stack
Packaged Compose
No rebuild / no pull

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Publish delivery artifact
Only push or manual dispatch on main
Retention: 7 days
